articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: ITW Schedules Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Earnings Webcast. GLENVIEW, Ill., Jan. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Illinois Tool Works Inc. (NYSE: ITW) will issue its fourth quarter and full year 2025 results on Tuesday, February 3, 2026, at 7:00 a.m. CST. Following the release, ITW will hold its fourth quarter and full year 2025 earnings webcast at 9:00 a.m. CST.
